about_the_game:
Dear Players, your daily hard work in "coin pushing" has finally touched Xiao Ji! She has prepared a special [Sweet Gift] for you. This gift will not only make your coin-pushing journey more smooth and exciting, but also take your relationship with this playful mascot to a whole new level!

Please note: The content of this DLC is extremely sweet and may cause accelerated heart rate, constant smiling, and an uncontrollable obsession with coin pushing.

Introduction to Core Content

Financial Freedom: Endless Coins!

Daily Login Gift Pack: Log in every day to get an extra 2000 coins! Say goodbye to frugality and take the first step towards coin-pushing freedom.

Continuous Supplies: The number of coins you can collect every 5 minutes has been greatly increased! Keep your "ammunition" fully stocked at all times, with no more worries, and enjoy the thrill of pushing piles of coins to your heart's content.

Visual Feast: Exclusive Outfit "Honey Mood"

Xiao Ji has put on an exclusive limited-edition outfit specially prepared for premium players!

This outfit features more exquisite and bold designs, perfectly showcasing Xiao Ji's charming appeal. Every detail glows with a "sweet" vibe, making your coin-pushing time both pleasing to the eye and delightful.

Emotional Connection Boost: Exclusive Interaction Privileges

Exclusive Voice Lines: Xiao Ji has prepared a full set of brand-new intimate voice lines for you, ranging from greetings and encouragement to whispers. Her voice is sweeter, and the content is more... personal. ("Master, I will guard your luck today!")

Dynamic Expressions and Actions: Xiao Ji is no longer a static mascot! She will give you richer dynamic feedback based on your operations: she will spin around when happy, cheer for you when you win a big prize, and even... (Wait for you to discover it yourself in the game!).

Hidden Dialogue Plot: Unlock the exclusive background story plot with Xiao Ji, gain a deeper understanding of this mysterious and lovely mascot, and let your relationship go beyond just inserting coins and pushing coins.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: After purchasing this DLC, will I still get the original 500 daily coins?

A: Of course! The 2000 coins from the DLC are an additional daily bonus, which is stacked with the 500 coins from the free version. You can get up to 2500 coins per day when you log in!

Q: Is the content of the DLC permanent?

A: Yes! One purchase, permanent enjoyment. This "Sweet Gift" will be with you forever.

Q: Will this DLC affect the game balance?

A: Not at all! It only helps you obtain in-game resources faster, reduce waiting time, and provides an unparalleled visual and emotional experience. All players face fair coin-pushing opportunities and challenges.

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content not suitable for all ages or for viewing at work: includes partial nudity.
